title: New Performance Max update almost nobody's talking about: you can pul...
description: New Performance Max update almost nobody's talking about: you can pull your existing Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, and X creative straight into Google PMax instead of rebuilding from scratch. #GoogleAds #PerformanceMax #PaidAds #PPC
transcript: Have you noticed this big update inside of Google Performance Max campaigns? You can now steal your social media creative and put it inside of this campaign. As you can see, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Instagram, TikTok, TikTok. I even spotted X ads in there. So Google is going out and pulling these creatives and then putting them inside of here for you to use. Basically piggybacking off of other ads from other channels that you might be running. Check it out. Makes my job a little bit easier when it comes to content for clients performance max campaigns.
